_about: Published aggregate of spck.dev's independent read-only probe of the public UCP merchant population. Population frame: HuggingFace dataset UCPChecker/ucp-merchants (CC-BY-4.0), status=verified. Probe: GET /.well-known/ucp with an identified User-Agent. No individual merchant is named; aggregates only. Reproducible.
signing_keys_note: WITHDRAWN FIGURE, annotated 2026-10-15, value left unchanged as a record of what this edition reported. signing_keys_present and signing_keys_pct from this run are wrong, not merely uncertain: the scanner tested keys[] against a population that publishes signing_keys[] (the field was renamed in ucp#566, merged 2026-07-12 and first released in the v2026-08-25 tag), so it could not see them and reported 0. The same defect affects the 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-13 runs. The last correct-field measurement is scan-2026-07-17.json: 11 of 2974 live valid endpoints. ops/tools/state_of_ucp_scan.py now tests both field names, so a future scan measures this correctly.
